_説明: Explanations shown when you click a word in the code (English). tools/make_glossaries.py makes this file from the dictionaries in tools/glossary/en/ (fix the dictionaries, not this file).
scipy: A library for scientific computing (statistics, optimization and so on)
ppf: From a lower-tail probability, finds the value at that point (percent point). ppf(0.975) is the upper 2.5% point
cdf: The cumulative distribution function (the probability of being at or below that value)
scale: The spread of the distribution (the mean for an exponential distribution)
statsmodels: A library for statistical models (regression analysis and so on)
sm: Uses statsmodels.api under the short name sm
api: The way into statsmodels' commonly used functions
add_constant: Adds a column of 1s for the intercept
summary: The table of regression results (coefficients, standard errors, t values, p values and so on)
outliers_influence: Tools for checking outliers and influence (VIF and so on)
variance_inflation_factor: VIF (variance inflation factor). A guide to multicollinearity; above 10 is strong
numpy: A library for fast calculations on arrays of numbers (vectors and matrices)
np: Uses NumPy under the short name np (import numpy as np)
np.array: Makes a NumPy array (a vector or matrix)
array: Makes a NumPy array (a vector or matrix)
shape: An array's shape (the number of elements in each direction). (rows, columns)
size: The total number of an array's elements
std: The standard deviation. ddof=1 divides by n−1 (unbiased)
var: The variance. ddof=1 divides by n−1 (unbiased variance)
ddof: Divides by n − ddof. ddof=1 gives the unbiased variance and standard deviation
cov: The variance–covariance matrix. rowvar=False means "each column is one variable"
default_rng: Makes a random number generator. With a seed, you get the same random numbers every time
exponential: Random numbers from an exponential distribution
norm: The length of a vector (its norm)
sqrt: Square root (element by element for arrays)
pandas: A library for handling table data (like Excel)
pd: Uses pandas under the short name pd (import pandas as pd)
Series: One column of pandas data (a named 1-D array)
values: The list of a dictionary's values. In pandas, takes out the contents as a NumPy array
import: Loads a module (another file or library). You can give it a short name with as, as in import numpy as np
from: Loads only part of a module. from datetime import date
as: Gives another name to something imported, or something opened with with
for: Takes the contents of a container one at a time and repeats
in: In for, "one at a time from..."; in a condition, "whether it is in..."
len: The length (number of elements or characters)
range: Makes a run of integers. range(5) is 0–4, range(1, 6) is 1–5
